· RSI trajectory (42.8→55.1) + confirmed exiting oversold and holding neutral zone + upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (860.9121→6382.5405) + improving + strengthening trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid $244,475) + band width at 30.81% suggests potential for increased volatility.

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.88x) + potential for reduced reliability due to sluggish movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (uptrend) + entry at $274,500, stop at $240,000, target at $370,000.
